gloss: back fat (pork fat used as a ramen topping)

definitions.explanation: Fat from the back of a pig, commonly used as a rich topping in ramen. It melts into the broth to add creaminess and depth.

examples.japanese: {背脂|せあぶら}⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like ramen with lots of back fat.
At this shop, you can choose the amount of back fat.

examples.japanese: {背脂|せあぶら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧な⟦コク→コク：20672_koku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Adding back fat gives the soup a rich depth of flavor.

notes:
Pork back fat, widely used as a topping in Japanese ramen. It is typically rendered or chopped and scattered over the surface of the broth, where it melts and adds richness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背脂|せあぶら}⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧ (loaded with back fat)
- {背脂|せあぶら}チャッチャ⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧ (back-fat-drizzled style ramen)
- {背脂|せあぶら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧ (top with back fat)

Particularly associated with {燕三条|つばめさんじょう} ramen from Niigata and certain Tokyo-style ramen shops. Some shops let customers specify the amount: ⟦{少|すく}なめ→少なめ：19120_sukuname⟧ (light), ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ (normal), or ⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧ (extra).
